eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computer Science with Advanced Power Technologies aims to bring together researchers, academicians, industry professionals, and practitioners to exchange innovative ideas, recent advancements, and practical experiences in the fields of electrical engineering, electronics, computer science, and advanced power technologies.  The conference focuses on emerging trends and interdisciplinary approaches that address current challenges and future directions in sustainable energy systems, intelligent control, and digital transformation of power and computing infrastructures.
